relations.name: CONTAINS
relations.meaning: Product system owns the capability family as a named product area (one family, one system).

relations.name: EXPOSES
relations.meaning: Named entrypoint is a primary caller surface for the family (MCP tool, CLI verb, or operator script).

relations.name: USES
relations.meaning: Family or workflow depends on a backend provider or another family at runtime (not ownership).

relations.name: PRODUCES
relations.meaning: Family/backend is the primary issuer of the artifact identity.

relations.name: CONSUMES
relations.meaning: Family/workflow/trust path reads or requires the artifact as an input (not mere adjacency).

relations.name: READS_WRITES
relations.meaning: Family reads and/or mutates the named durable or process state item as part of its contract.

relations.name: ESCALATES_TO
relations.meaning: Router may advance from one acquisition backend to another under the corrected cascade ladder (not dual-fail ranking).

relations.name: PROVES
relations.meaning: Trust primitive cryptographically or procedurally binds claims about the target artifact class — see TRUST-MODEL for exact scope (never overclaim).

relations.name: VERIFIES
relations.meaning: Family or entrypoint exercises the trust primitive as a checker (offline/live/prove/citation/history/manifest).

relations.name: COMPOSES_INTO
relations.meaning: Family/entrypoint is a load-bearing step in a proven FLOW/CMP composition (not every possible call order).

relations.name: GATED_BY
relations.meaning: Reachability requires an opt-in env gate, profile, or ambient state; absence removes the surface (not a soft preference).

relations.name: DEGRADES_TO
relations.meaning: Failure or honesty path: success path collapses to a typed failure family, negative receipt, or weaker trust primitive without inventing content.
